caller_sites.log_callee: 0x5fceda0, recorded but not modelled; it changes no group, slot, or flag

first.format: [%s:4376] [%s]CF has reserved epoch number %lu for files ingested behind since `Options::allow_ingest_behind` is true

second.format: [%s:4404] [%s]CF's epoch numbers are inferred based on seqno

layout.arg2_flag: arg2 + 0x4fb, byte selecting the first log call
layout.obj_fd4: obj + 0xfd4, written to 1 only on the stamp path
layout.obj_groups: obj + 0xa98, 24-byte entries: begin qword, end qword, third qword never read

unknowns: The domain meaning of the groups and of the +0xd0 stamp beyond the quoted log strings is not claimed.
The other predicate call site 0x5f52d1a and the caller's direct-call site 0x5eeaa6f and tail-jump site 0x5d8ce6f are sites only, not modelled.
The log callee 0x5fceda0 and its argument-to-format mapping are not modelled.
The native %rax on return (log callee return on the stamp path, previous slot value on the max path) is not part of the pinned contract.

caller.claim: entry writes 1 to the arg2+0x9e0 slot; flag byte selects a first log call; predicate decides the stamp path (reverse groups, per-group value, group 0 per-element, then obj+0xfd4 = 1) or the max path (slot = max(max_stamp + 1, slot))

maximum.claim: largest element stamp over groups[0:count] under an unsigned compare, starting from 0; empty selection yields 0

predicate.claim: returns 1 when any element in groups[0:count] has stamp 0, else 0; non-positive count returns 0 without reading groups
